zh-CN->en:按登记时间所在自然月汇总工单数量，呈现月度波动与业务峰值。: The number of work orders is summarized according to the natural month of registration time, showing monthly fluctuations and business peaks.
zh-CN->en:统计各自然月登记工单中仍处于检查或维修阶段的比例，用于评估滞: The proportion of registered work orders that are still in the inspection or maintenance stage in each natural month is counted to assess the risk of detention.
zh-CN->en:基于问题描述文本进行分词与词频统计，辅助发现重复表述及潜在风: Carry out word segmentation and word frequency statistics based on the problem description text to help discover repeated expressions and potential risk topics, and can be cross-analyzed with the problem type field.
zh-CN->en:基于在册工单统计各流程节点占比，用于定位流程瓶颈与滞留环节。: The proportion of each process node is calculated based on the registered work orders, which is used to locate process bottlenecks and stranded links.
zh-CN->en:对问题描述进行词频提取与可视化，识别高频表述及潜在共性问题，: Extract and visualize word frequency for problem descriptions, identify high-frequency expressions and potential common problems, and compare and analyze them with standard problem types.
zh-CN->en:按巡查区域与关联车间展示登记量走势，用于识别重点区域与跨部门: The registration volume trend is displayed according to the inspection area and related workshops, which is used to identify key areas and cross-department collaborative pressure.
zh-CN->en:展示检查中、维修中与已办结等状态占比，用于评估在办积压与处置: Displays the proportion of statuses such as Inspection, Maintenance and Completed, which is used to evaluate the backlog and disposal pressure.
zh-CN->en:呈现流程节点占比、月度办结率及未结工单结构，便于例会复盘与责: The proportion of process nodes, monthly completion rate and open work order structure are presented to facilitate review of regular meetings and implementation of responsibilities.
zh-CN->en:汇总问题类型占比、各月登记量及处置阶段分布，支撑排班与现场资: Summarize the proportion of problem types, monthly registration volume and disposal stage distribution to support shift scheduling and on-site resource allocation.
zh-CN->en:仅统计未办结工单，按责任人聚合（未指定责任人时取登记人），便: Only open work orders are counted and aggregated by responsible person (if no responsible person is designated, the registrant is taken) to facilitate regular meeting supervision and coordination.

zh-CN->en:在仓储收发频繁或需与总账对齐的场景下，应选择业务相对静止的时: In scenarios where warehousing is frequently sent and received or needs to be aligned with the general ledger, a time point when the business is relatively static should be selected, and the deadline should be confirmed by finance.

zh-CN->en:若无未结案在制品，可跳过本步骤。导入须包含：产品编码、工序编: If there is no pending work-in-progress, you can skip this step. The import must include: product code, process code, and work in progress quantity.

zh-CN->en:数量、单价、金额分项设定，默认均为 2 位，可配置范围 0–: The quantity, unit price, and amount sub-item settings are all 2 digits by default, and the configurable range is 0–4.

zh-CN->en:不再嵌入第三方流程控制台；任务状态请通过业务界面、日志与数据: Third-party process consoles are no longer embedded; task status can be viewed through the Taskiq queue table in the business interface, logs, and database.

zh-CN->en:请先在「功能权限」中勾选至少一项，再配置字段显示方式: Please check at least one item in "Function Permissions" first, and then configure the field display method
zh-CN->en:功能权限控制可访问的菜单与操作。可选全部、按 APP（一级）: Function permissions control accessible menus and operations. You can select all, filter by APP (level 1), module (level 2) or search (level 3 and above); shortcut operations only apply to the currently visible range.
